_comment: The full-affordance table. accent=0 holds a bare severity word; row 4
holds a badge-tone word instead ('kev'), which must map through
_BADGE_TONES to a-critical. Row 5's accent matches neither and must get
no accent class at all. Row 6 is SHORT -- fewer cells than columns -- so
every index lookup has to tolerate a missing cell rather than throw.
0->0. The 12/47 case is the one that catches a renderer that rounds:
floor gives 25, half-up gives 26.
